preamble.summary: Deuteronomy 19 establishes the cities of refuge and rules of evidence (two-or-three-witnesses). 4QDeutᵏ² preserves vv. 8–16. 4QDeutᵖ contains fragments of vv. 2–3. Coverage is moderate.
preamble.notable_variants: No significant content variants. The two-or-three-witnesses requirement (v. 15, cited at Matt 18:16; 2 Cor 13:1; 1 Tim 5:19; Heb 10:28) tracks MT.
preamble.scroll_condition: Fragmentary; readings of v. 15 are well preserved.

variant_notes: 'On the evidence of two witnesses or three witnesses shall a charge be established' tracks MT. The DSS confirm the Hebrew Vorlage of NT citations (Matt 18:16; 2 Cor 13:1; 1 Tim 5:19; Heb 10:28).
